description: Fixture state sales-tax rate placeholders for landed-cost estimation in the fixture-mode validation beta. Rates are modeled on typical state-level rate magnitudes but are NOT verified against any revenue department, exclude local/county surtaxes entirely, and must always render as labeled estimates.

provenance.limitations: Fixture placeholder rates for the validation beta. State-level only (no local surtaxes), unverified, estimate-grade. Not tax advice; totals using these rates must render as estimates with this caveat.
